title: Robert Half selected by Fortune as one of the Best Workplaces in Consulting & Professional Services 2026
summary: Global talent solutions and business consulting firm Robert Half (NYSE: RHI) has been named one of Fortune's Best Workplaces in Consulting & Professional Services for 2026. Robert Half's...
body_markdown:
MENLO PARK, Calif.


, Oct. 1, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Global talent solutions and business consulting firm[Robert Half](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4787997-1&h=2956840310&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.roberthalf.com%2Fus%2Fen&a=Robert+Half) (NYSE: RHI) has been named one of[Fortune's Best Workplaces in Consulting & Professional Services](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4787997-1&h=3159781957&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.greatplacetowork.com%2Fbest-workplaces%2Fconsulting%2F2026%3Fcategory%3Dlarge&a=Fortune%27s+Best+Workplaces+in+Consulting+%26+Professional+Services) for 2026. Robert Half's consulting subsidiary, Protiviti, was also recognized, reflecting the strong workplace cultures across both organizations.


Compiled in partnership with Great Place to Work®, the rankings are based on an analysis of employee feedback and company practices. More than 125,000 employees at Great Place to Work Certified™ organizations in the consulting and professional services industry were surveyed. Companies were selected based on their ability to deliver positive outcomes for employees regardless of job function, work status or demographic background.


"Being recognized as one of the Best Workplaces in Consulting and Professional Services is a reflection of the workplace culture our employees help create every day," said M. Keith Waddell, president and chief executive officer of Robert Half. "We are committed to fostering an environment where people feel supported, valued and empowered to do their best work while building meaningful careers."


In the company's 2026[Great Place To Work® survey](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4787997-1&h=1522999454&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.greatplacetowork.com%2Fcertified-company%2F1000216&a=Great+Place+To+Work%C2%AE%C2%A0survey) , 92% of employees at Robert Half said their organization is a great place to work, compared to 57% at a typical U.S.-based company.


**FAQs**
**How were companies selected for this recognition?**
Companies were selected based on employee survey responses and their ability to deliver consistently positive workplace experiences for all employees, regardless of job function, work status or demographic background. The methodology evaluates factors such as trust, respect, fairness, pride and camaraderie in the workplace.


**Why was Robert Half recognized?** Robert Half was recognized for fostering a workplace culture where employees can thrive professionally and personally. The company is committed to supporting employee well-being, growth and connection. In the company's 2026 Great Place To Work® survey, 92% of employees said Robert Half is a great place to work, compared to 57% at a typical U.S.-based company.


**What does this recognition mean for Robert Half?**
This recognition reinforces Robert Half's reputation as an employer of choice in the consulting and professional services industry. It highlights the company's ongoing commitment to creating a positive employee experience and investing in an organizational culture that attracts, develops, and retains top talent.


**About Robert Half**
Robert Half (NYSE: RHI) is the world's first and largest specialized talent solutions and business consulting firm, connecting highly skilled job seekers with rewarding opportunities at great companies. We offer contract talent and full-time solutions in the fields of finance and accounting, technology, marketing and creative, legal, and administrative and customer support, and we also provide executive search services.


Robert Half is the parent company of Protiviti®, a global consulting firm that delivers internal audit, risk, business and technology consulting solutions. In the last 12 months, Robert Half has been recognized as one of America's Most Innovative Companies by Fortune and, with Protiviti, has been named a Fortune® Most Admired Company™ and one of the 100 Best Companies to Work For.
